# Blue Digital Core

Independent digital studio run by Blue. This domain hosts two things.

- Blue Digital Core: https://bluedigitalcore.github.io/
- Let Me Dress Your Avatar: https://bluedigitalcore.github.io/let-me-dress-your-avatar/

## Let Me Dress Your Avatar

Custom outfit design for AI avatars.

Instagram: https://instagram.com/letmedressyouravatar

You send a face and body reference for your AI avatar and say what occasion you
need. Finished outfit renders come back within 48 hours. Every look is delivered
as a front view and a back view. There is no preset catalogue and no fixed menu:
each outfit is designed for the occasion you describe.

### Pricing

Wardrobe Drop. 37 USD, one time.

- 5 custom looks, any occasion
- Front and back view of every look
- Delivered in 48 hours
- One round of revisions within 5 days

Monthly Wardrobe. 67 USD per month.

- 8 custom looks a month, delivered as two drops of 4 or one drop of 8
- Front and back view of every look
- 48 hours per drop
- One revision round per drop
- Cancel anytime

After checkout the buyer receives a short intake form to send avatar references
and describe what they want.

Looks designed through the wardrobe service are the buyer's to use commercially.

### Exclusivity

The wardrobe service is one to one. Looks are designed for a single buyer, belong
to that buyer alone, and are never reused or featured in any prompt pack.

### Ready-made prompt packs

Separate from the done-for-you service, there are self-serve AI image prompt packs
sold through Beacons. These are prompts the buyer runs themselves, not finished
renders made to order, and every buyer of a pack can create the same outfits from
it. They are not exclusive, unlike the wardrobe service:

- Dressed to Haunt, a Halloween costume prompt pack
- Emoji Couture, wear the emoji
- Lace and Vows, a lingerie prompt bundle

### Work shown on the site

20 example looks, filterable by occasion: Elegant, Casual, Swimwear, Gym Wear and
Everyday. New work is posted to Instagram.
